requires.degrade: Without jq, /planning:wayfind cannot read the container label from .work-item-tracker.json and falls back to work-map, and fetch-docs.sh exits before reading anything, so /planning:draft-goal-condition reads the /goal page with WebFetch instead.

Without Python 3, the interview surface (the browser round page and watcher) is unavailable and /planning:interview asks its questions inline; the plan and brainstorm views cannot reach the session and close the loop with a copied reply. A docs page that serves only HTML cannot be converted and is recorded unread with reason no-python.

Without curl, the planning surface and the plan and brainstorm view watchers do not start; the questions are answered in chat and the views close the loop with a copied reply. fetch-docs.sh records a docs page unread with reason curl-missing, so /planning:draft-goal-condition reads the /goal page with WebFetch instead.
Without node, the prerequisites checker cannot run, so a missing tool above goes unreported; the plugin's own skills are unaffected.
